author: Böhlke & Böhlke, 1976

note.en: A small, secretive moray of shallow reef crevices, known here from two museum records.
note.es: Una morena pequeña y esquiva de grietas someras del arrecife, conocida aquí por dos registros de museo.

recWhy: Two museum records in the region with no named site.

marks.en: Chestnut-brown moray with a hooked snout and long curved teeth.
marks.es: Morena castaña con hocico ganchudo y dientes largos y curvados.
